crossRefs.note: His children will seek the favor of the poor. His hands will give back his wealth.
He will restore that for which he labored, and will not swallow it down. He will not rejoice according to the substance…
whose harvest the hungry eats up, and take it even out of the thorns. The snare gapes for their substance.
If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring will not be satisfied with bread.
‘Behold, the days come that all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have laid up in store to this day…
For in an hour such great riches are made desolate.’ Every ship master, and everyone who sails anywhere, and mariners…
Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.
Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them in the day of Yahweh’s wrath, but the whole land will…
For what will it profit a man, if he gains the whole world, and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange…
Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.

translations.web: The increase of his house will depart. They will rush away in the day of his wrath.
translations.bsb: The possessions of his house will be removed, flowing away on the day of God’s wrath.
translations.kjv: The increase of his house shall depart, and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.
translations.asv: The increase of his house shall depart; His goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.
